description: This file defines a Tokenizer class used to split strings into tokens based on delimiters, supporting multi-character delimiters via regex patterns, with options to trim tokens. It is part of a calculator or expression evaluation library.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A tokenizer class that splits input strings into tokens using single or multi-character delimiters, with optional trimming of whitespace. It includes internal classes for token iteration.

methods.name: Tokenizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tokenizer with a list of delimiters, adapting for single-character delimiters or complex regex patterns.

methods.name: isTrimTokens
methods.description: Returns whether tokens are trimmed during tokenization.

methods.name: setTrimTokens
methods.description: Sets whether tokens should be trimmed.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts a string into an iterator over tokens based on the specified delimiters and trimming options.
